title: fix(approvals)!: a request whose stamped flow package was uninstalled never reads another package's flow of that name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Fixes #32647

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or docs page teaches how an approval request reads its flow once its package is uninstalled; the moved answers are runtime refusals at approval doors, nothing an author writes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：审批单记着打开它的包（`process_package`）。这个包卸载后，如果另一个包还发同名 flow，审批单不再去读那个包的 flow：退回（send-back）和停滞的重新提交改为 409 拒绝并列出所有持有者，详情读取不再给出 `flow_route` / `flow_steps`，队列包按"没有 flow"处理。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0150 D8 R7 规定审批单属于打开它的那个包的 flow；之前卸载后会按裸名或按运行的 key 读到别的包的同名 flow，审批人看到并操作的是一张从没跑过这单的流程图。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响"打开它的包已卸载、而别的包持有同名 flow"的审批单（第一方调用方 0 个）；记下的包仍持有该名、单子没记包、或已无任何持有者时答案不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 的 `requestFlowSlot`（新增已卸载分支）、`requestFlow`（拒绝）、`requestFlowKey`；再看 `approval-revise.test.ts` 新增的 `[#32647]` describe。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/approval-revise.test.ts`，预期 29 个用例全绿，其中 3 个是 `[#32647]`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ApprovalService.requestFlowSlot` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`) now answers a request stamped with a package (`process_package`) by that package's slot ONLY. When the stamped package holds no slot of the request's flow name (uninstalled, or no longer shipping the flow), it answers a withdrawn marker naming the slots that do hold the name, and never falls through to the run's key or the bare read: both served another package's flow (the bare read once a second holder was left alone; the run's key once another package installed the name after the stamped package left, because the key is the bare name again).

- `requestFlow` (send-back's edge check, the stranded-resubmit continuation's revise window, the request read's `flow_route` / `flow_steps`): a withdrawn stamp with holders throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), reason `not-held-by-qualifier` with the stamped package as the qualifier and every holder as a candidate, and a sentence of the request's own (the qualifier read's "address it by its holder" is no move an approver has). With no holder left it answers `null`, the deleted-flow answer the bare read gave, unchanged.
- `requestFlowKey` (the queue package a re-resolved slate reads a `queue` name from): a withdrawn stamp answers `null`, the no-flow answer.
- The request-open path (`input.flowName`, no package asked) is unchanged; it narrows the new union type away.

Declared FROM → TO per door, for a request whose stamped package withdrew while another package holds the name:

| Door | FROM (measured, ablation) | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|
| send-back (`POST /approvals/requests/ID/revise`) | the other package's revise edge checked; unit harness, run carrying the bare name: request `returned` on the other graph; booted stack, record-triggered run: passes the edge check, then `409 RESUME_TARGET_LOST` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder, nothing written |
| request read `flow_route` / `flow_steps` | the other package's route and steps (`Iota gate`) | neither served |
| stranded resubmit's revise window | the other package's window (`wait_revision`) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` |
| queue package | the other package (`com.acme.beta`) | none (environment-wide read) |

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-revise.test.ts`, new `[#32647]` describe beside the `[#31696]` one (real `AutomationEngine`, loader set attached so the queue door's package is readable): (1) withdrawn beside a second holder, (2) install / open / uninstall / another package installs the name (with a CONTROL leg: no holder left answers as a deleted flow, as on `main`), (3) CONTROL: stamped package still holds the name, alone and beside a second holder, every door reads its own flow.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts`, new top-level describe on a booted stack: host stack + install-local alpha, open a request through alpha's record-triggered flow, `DELETE /marketplace/install-local/ALPHA`, CONTROL (no holder: send-back `VALIDATION_FAILED`, no route or steps), install iota's same-named flow (filed under the bare key the run carries), then send-back `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming alpha and iota, read with no route or steps, row still `pending`.

## Acceptance notes

- One-holder answers are unchanged and pinned (CONTROL test 3, and the `[#31696]` describe stays green).
- In the unit harness, a run started by bare name while its package was the name's one holder resumed on the other package's graph once that package held the name (the send-back FROM `returned` above): the engine's run-key lookup, not this service's. On the booted stack the record-triggered run carried its package-qualified key and the engine refused the resume (`RESUME_TARGET_LOST`). Not measured through a public door for a by-name run; carrier: none.
- Local gates were targeted per the dispatch (affected package tests and typecheck, the new pins, one ablation per moved answer); CI runs the farm.
